test_model_on_data: test a PyTorch model on test data and compute loss metrics with TensorBoard logging
test_model_with_visualization: test a model on test data and save ground truth vs prediction visualization images
test_model_with_summary_fn: test a model on test data and log custom image summaries to TensorBoard
test_model_with_batch_filter: test a model on test data with a custom batch filter function applied per batch
test_model_return_loss_means: test a model on test data and return a dictionary of mean loss values per metric
